description: This file defines a REST API resource class for managing external event configurations in the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to list all current configurations and to enable or disable external event posting, utilizing annotations for Swagger documentation, validation, and dependency injection.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for managing external event configurations, supporting listing and updating configurations with dependency injection and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getExternalEventConfigurations
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all external event configurations by invoking the read platform service.

methods.name: updateExternalEventConfigurations
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update external event configuration settings, creating a command and processing it through the command pipeline to produce a response.
